rows.en:
This goes like this, so...
then a twiddly-tweak right here......
rows.notes: Chochoi no choi: 'twiddly-tweak' as in c14091/c20243.

rows.en: (Hoshimura's tinkering with machines again...)

Hoshimura, why'd you join the Pilot Course?
If you love machines that much, you should've
just joined the Maintenance Course.
rows.notes: Seibi kousu -> 'Maintenance Course' (not in the glossary), by analogy with Pilot Course.

rows.en: Well, that's, um... lemme see...
Is there some reason that's hard to talk about?

Well, actually, I kinda flunked
the Maintenance Course exam...

What?! But you're great at maintenance
and stuff, Hoshimura... How come?

Hmmm, during the test I got a little too fired up
and made some crazy modifications, see...

Crazy enough to fail you...?
What on earth did you do?
Well, there was a teeny little explosion...
Well, yeah, that'll get you failed...

(That's such a Hoshimura reason.
What a waste, when she's got the skills...)
(Yui's tinkering with machines again...)

Yui, why'd you join the Pilot Course?
If you love machines that much, you should've
just joined the Maintenance Course.
Is there some reason that's hard to talk about?

What?! But you're great at maintenance
and stuff, Yui... How come?

Crazy enough to fail you...?
What on earth did you do?
Well, yeah, that'll get you failed...

(That's such a Yui reason.
What a waste, when she's got the skills...)

(I'm done with my early-morning workout.
What should I do now...?)

\p-kun,
what are you worrying about?
Oh, Akimizu. Did I look like that?

Well, of course. It looked like you were
groaning "hmmm, hmmm" to yourself...
Was it really that bad...?
So, what are you worrying about?

It's not that I'm worried, exactly...
I was just wondering how to spend
the rest of the day...

Oh, I know that feeling! Whatever you do,
there's always something to worry about, right?

If I go to a festival, I get bitten by bugs,
and if I eat soft serve, I get fat,

if I go to the pool, swimsuits are embarrassing,
and if I so much as step outside, I get sunburned...

I really end up not being able to do
anything at all...
Th-That does sound rough...
(Akimizu's worries are kinda... out there...)
rows.notes: Bimyou na nayami: 'iffy/odd worries'; female twin c20383 says 'off-the-charts' (ketahazure), so the two differ as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
(I'm done with my early-morning workout.
What should I do now...?)

\p-chan,
what are you worrying about?
Oh, Yuu. Did I look like that?
Was it... really that bad...?
Th-That does sound rough...
(Yuu worries on a whole other level...)

(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon.
I can't wait.)

What's up, \p-kun?
You look kind of happy...

Yeah, I was just thinking Sheryl's concert
is coming up soon...

Oh, that's right, it is.
You're working at the concert as staff, right?

Yeah, that's right.
Aren't you going to go see it, Akimizu?
Oh, um... I'm interested, but... well...
Yeah? What's wrong?

...Um, I'm just... not very good...
with big crowds...

Oh, really!
That's kind of a shame, though.
It's such a great chance...

You're right. Maybe I'll try harder
next time...
(I bet Akimizu won't go next time either...)

What's up, \p-chan?
You look kind of happy...

Yeah, I was just thinking Sheryl's concert
is coming up soon...

Yeah, that's right.
Aren't you going to go see it, Yuu?
(I bet Yuu won't go next time either...)
(I wonder what the new planet is like...)

What's wrong, \p-kun?
You've got a serious look on your face.

Oh, Akimizu.
I was just thinking about the new planet...

I see... You really do end up thinking
about all kinds of things, huh?
Not that I ever come up with any answers...
rows.notes: Akimizu drops into casual speech here (shared male/female, her name plate in both). Kept as her line; 'I' restored for the speaker's own fruitless musing.

rows.en:
Yeah, there's just no end to imagining it...
Which is kind of obvious, but...
But isn't it fine as long as it's fun?

It's like anything else. If imagining makes you
happy, I think you should do as much as you want.
After all, it's something you can only do now...
You might be right.

Yes! So I think you should just
enjoy the here and now!
Yeah, thanks!
(Akimizu sure says some good stuff!)
(I wonder what the new planet is like...)

What's wrong, \p-chan?
You've got a serious look on your face.

Oh, Yuu.
I was just thinking about the new planet...

Yeah, there's just no end to imagining it...
Which is kind of obvious, though...
Yeah, thanks!
(Yuu sure says some good stuff!)

uncertain: c20402: Akimizu speaks casually (sou nanda... kangaechau yo ne) unlike her usual polite speech; kept as her line (name plate in both variants), 'I' restored for the fruitless musing.
c20377: bimyou na nayami rendered '(Akimizu's worries are kinda... out there...)'; the female twin (c20383, ketahazure) differs in the Japanese too.
missing_glossary: Seibi kousu -> 'Maintenance Course' (c20348, c20351, c20359), by analogy with Pilot Course.
